title: EVERY DOOR
note: Figures and quotes are from the Anchorage Daily News (October 4th), the UAA Student Handbook and the UAA catalog; illustrations are editorial and the doors are illustrative.

lines.text: At the University of Alaska, there's no single A I rule. It hangs on the classroom door.
lines.t: At the University of Alaska, there's no single A I rule. It hangs on the classroom door.

lines.text: UAA's student handbook bars devices not authorized by the faculty member. That section never says A I.
lines.t: UAA's student handbook bars devices not authorized by the faculty member. That section never says A I.

lines.text: Faculty set A I rules course by course, the Daily News reports. Watch the last door.
lines.t: Faculty set A I rules course by course, the Daily News reports. Watch the last door.

lines.text: A UAA report, via the Daily News, says a hundred nineteen of a hundred fifty students cited for academic misconduct used A I.
lines.t: A UAA report, via the Daily News, says a hundred nineteen of a hundred fifty students cited for academic misconduct used A I.

lines.text: It says A I cases are most of what the conduct office handles, and A I use for plagiarism rose seventy three percent last year.
lines.t: It says A I cases are most of what the conduct office handles, and A I use for plagiarism rose seventy three percent last year.

lines.text: Those hundred nineteen are one point one percent of more than ten thousand five hundred students. But a citation isn't a count of use.
lines.t: Those hundred nineteen are one point one percent of more than ten thousand five hundred students. But a citation isn't a count of use.

lines.text: The regents, the governing board, have a draft of A I principles.
lines.t: The regents, the governing board, have a draft of A I principles.

lines.text: Stephanie Erickson presented that draft. She said, per the Daily News, we need to be deliberate with how we want to engage with A I.
lines.t: Stephanie Erickson presented that draft. She said, per the Daily News, we need to be deliberate with how we want to engage with A I.

lines.text: The best case for the doors? In a writing course, A I can let students skip the learning.
lines.t: The best case for the doors? In a writing course, A I can let students skip the learning.

lines.text: The last door? UAA's master's program in A I, data science and engineering. There, A I is the subject.
lines.t: The last door? UAA's master's program in A I, data science and engineering. There, A I is the subject.

lines.text: Same tool, two doors, opposite answers. One rule would fit neither.
lines.t: Same tool, two doors, opposite answers. One rule would fit neither.

lines.text: Students still need to know which door they're at.
lines.t: Students still need to know which door they're at.

lines.text: In November, regents will consider guiding principles. That's a place to start, not a rule.
lines.t: In November, regents will consider guiding principles. That's a place to start, not a rule.

lines.text: Should the university set one default for authorized A I use, or leave it to each faculty member?
lines.t: Should the university set one default for authorized A I use, or leave it to each faculty member?
